rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent low long-span gym volume in all four views, with a consistent sheared/profiled roof language rather than a random stack of parts. The dominant mass is legible and the section profile supports a hall-like program, so the gymnasium brief passes. The blue access edge is acknowledged only weakly: there is some edge offset/threshold logic, but the void/public response is limited and the ground plane remains mostly sealed. The silhouette is coherent, though still somewhat generic and box-dependent, with the stepped/profiled roof contributing more than a truly carved public court would. Overall this is program-appropriate and repairable, but it would benefit from a clearer public notch/canopy or court opening at the access side.
